finding: Original FP32 norm-gate callback is finite. Original BF16->FP16 conversion introduces one -Inf in the FLA seed; all saved native endpoints are finite. This contaminates the original FLA coefficients and subsequently conv-SiLU. This numerical defect is distinct from joint-reference attribution error.
